title: Investment structure under alternative preference weights
note: J is not comparable across weights; this compares each optimized amount. Positive investment is not a forced ratio.

title: 600 joint-perturbation scenarios: fixed-policy robustness
note: Independent uniform sampling; all-hard-constraint feasible share = 40.8%; this is not a real-world success rate or confidence interval. Violations may overlap.

title: Local policy slice over tax and fund transfer
note: Community share and measures held at recommended; grey is infeasible/undefined. A 2-D slice, not proof of global optimality.

title: Random-search variation and local refinement
note: A randomization check, not a convergence curve; three seeds do not prove global optimality.

title: Re-optimization after disabling feedback channels
note: Zero-effect channels are set to zero spend among equal scores; this is not a minimum-spend constraint.
